acceptanceCriteria: A test or code citation establishes whether barrier and reconcile writes remove orphan staging slots.
The failure row states the observed behavior; if it changes requirement text, the change follows spec-driven acceptance.
body: docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md:5803 (killed writer between first staged artifact and head) says 'Barrier and reconcile writes do not recover: another writer must run first.' internal/tasks/store/barrier.go:72 calls redoPendingFor(repo, session, request.Operation), which suggests barrier does redo a pending receipt. Suspected stale text, not a confirmed bug: it is unverified whether redoPendingFor also removes orphan descriptor-less slots (the CAL-V0-019 recovery) or only redoes a linked receipt. Found while reviewing V1-0825 (CTS-V0-008, decision 0490, PR beamfall/corvint#734). Resolve by reading the barrier path and, if needed, a focused test with orphan slots.
